rationale: Four Toffoli pairs (T1/T9, T2/T8, T3/T7, T4/T6) compute the same AND: in each, the second control c is changed in between only as c -> NOT(c xor a), so a AND c is unchanged, and the target is only read in between. Each pair, and the mirror pair P0, therefore takes a via-ancilla temporary AND (4 T), and the lone T5 takes a Jones Toffoli (4 T), for 24 T total, which looks like the floor for this toolbox. This keeps the accepted 24-T routing and tries the untried pyzx_then_tket global pass to lower T-depth.
